basis: Very-long-chain aldehyde decarbonylase for cuticular wax; whole-mount in situ in plumose stigma, cl5 log2FC 3.5, pct 0.42 vs 0.02 (Li et al. 2023 Dev Cell). Stigma-specific only within pistil samples: in whole-panicle data it marks anther/hull epidermis (in situ, Wang et al. 2025 Nature) and its mutant phenotype is in anther walls (Jung et al. 2006 Plant Cell).

Uncharacterized gene; whole-mount in situ in plumose stigma, cl5 log2FC 2.2, pct 0.26 vs 0.04 (Li et al. 2023 Dev Cell). Symbol error in the paper: OsMTP11/CS1 is the adjacent locus Os01g0837800 (LOC_Os01g62070, Oryzabase); the probe and Table S1 row are Os01g0837700. No MSU ID found: map with --id-column alt_id.

YABBY gene required for carpel specification in rice (mutant + in situ in carpel primordia; Yamaguchi et al. 2004 Plant Cell). Highest in the young ovary-wall cluster cl7 in Li et al. 2023 Dev Cell (Fig. S5A) and enriched in the carpel/pistil ('Stigmata') cluster of Wang et al. 2025 Nature; cross-study agreement raised medium to high. Also marks leaf midrib, so pistil-scoped.

C-class MADS gene for stamen and carpel identity (Yamaguchi et al. 2006 Plant Cell); enriched in cl7 and cl2 (Li et al. 2023 Dev Cell, Fig. S5B). Organ-level, not a cell type; also expected in stamen contaminant nuclei.

C-class MADS gene (carpel determinacy; Yamaguchi et al. 2006 Plant Cell); cl2 marker in Li et al. 2023 Dev Cell (Fig. S5C) and enriched in the carpel/pistil ('Stigmata') cluster of Wang et al. 2025 Nature. Not raised: the two studies place it in different compartments (outer epidermis cl2 vs whole pistil), and it is organ-level.

MYB-related sugar-response factor; in situ in the ovary wall, cl7 log2FC 3.4, pct 0.48 vs 0.03 (Li et al. 2023 Dev Cell). cl7 is the authors' 'young carpel' (high DL/OsMADS3/58), so this may mark an immature ovary-wall state rather than all ovary-wall cells.
Boron efflux transporter; in situ in the ovary wall, cl7 log2FC 3.0, pct 0.29 vs 0.04 (Li et al. 2023 Dev Cell). Same young-carpel caveat as OsMYBS2. MSU ID from Oryzabase (UniProt entries unnamed).

AP2/ERF factor; in situ on the outer surface of the ovary wall, cl1 log2FC 2.2, pct 0.25 vs 0.03 (Li et al. 2023 Dev Cell). ERF and wounding-enriched module, so check for a stress component before relying on it.
Uncharacterized protein kinase; in situ on the outer surface of the ovary wall, cl1 log2FC 1.5, pct 0.27 vs 0.06 (Li et al. 2023 Dev Cell). No MSU ID found: map with --id-column alt_id.
Hybrid proline-rich protein (Oryzabase synonym OsHyPRP19); in situ on the outer surface of the ovary wall, cl2 log2FC 2.9, pct 0.62 vs 0.12 (Li et al. 2023 Dev Cell).
Mitochondrial aldehyde dehydrogenase; in situ on the outer surface of the ovary wall, cl2 log2FC 2.2, pct 0.47 vs 0.08 (Li et al. 2023 Dev Cell).

GDSL lipase; in situ on the inner surface of the ovary wall AND the outer integument, cl9 log2FC 3.4, pct 0.51 vs 0.03 (Li et al. 2023 Dev Cell; authors call cl9 mixed). Marks both locule-facing layers; split with Integument/Ovary_Wall rows.
Aquaporin NIP1-1; cl9 marker (log2FC 2.6, pct 0.37 vs 0.05) with an in situ probe in Table S5 but no image described in the text (Li et al. 2023 Dev Cell). Same mixed-cluster caveat as OsGELP24.
Uncharacterized oxidoreductase-like gene; in situ in the style, but weak specificity (cl4 pct 0.29 vs 0.11) (Li et al. 2023 Dev Cell). cl4 was published as 'ovary wall'. No MSU ID found.

Calmodulin-like protein; in situ on either side of the basal style (starch-rich region), cl6 pct 0.26 vs 0.07 (Li et al. 2023 Dev Cell). cl6 was published as 'ovary wall'. Table S5 lists it as cluster 5 (S5 cluster column is wrong; Table S1 gives cl6).
Uncharacterized gene; in situ on either side of the basal style, cl6 pct 0.20 vs 0.04 (Li et al. 2023 Dev Cell). No MSU ID found.

D-lineage (STK-like) MADS gene; controls ovule identity, in situ in ovule primordia and integuments (Dreni et al. 2007 Plant J); in situ across the young ovule, cl10 log2FC 3.6, pct 0.80 vs 0.12 (Li et al. 2023 Dev Cell). Wang et al. 2025 Nature used it as the in situ probe of a pistil cluster they called 'stigma' (reinterpreted as carpel/ovule). Pan-ovule; strongest in young ovules.
Endo-1,4-beta-glucanase; in situ across the young ovule, cl10 pct 0.52 vs 0.01 (Li et al. 2023 Dev Cell). Young-ovule stage marker.
YABBY7; top cl10 DE gene (pct 0.46 vs 0.004) without in situ (Li et al. 2023 Dev Cell). Young-ovule stage; check in data.

AGL6-like MADS gene (floral organ identity; Ohmori et al. 2009 Plant Cell); in situ in the integuments (inner vs outer not resolved), cl3 pct 0.28 vs 0.04 (Li et al. 2023 Dev Cell). Also expressed in palea, lodicule and floral meristem, so integument-specific only within pistil samples.

Non-protein-coding transcript; in situ in the integuments, cl3 log2FC 3.6, pct 0.56 vs 0.07 (Li et al. 2023 Dev Cell). ID only in the paper's Tables S1/S5 (not in UniProt or Oryzabase); may be absent from other annotations. No MSU ID.

Lipid transfer protein; in situ at the chalazal end of the ovule and the attached ovary wall, cl8 log2FC 3.3, pct 0.30 vs 0.03 (Li et al. 2023 Dev Cell). The cluster probably includes the ovular vascular region.
RING-H2 E3 ligase (Oryzabase ATL32/OsRING329); in situ at the chalazal end of the ovule, cl8 log2FC 2.6, pct 0.30 vs 0.02 (Li et al. 2023 Dev Cell).

B-sister MADS gene required for PCD of the nucellus and nucellar projection (Yin and Xue 2012 Plant Cell); shown in the 2N nucellus cluster (Fig. 5E) of Li et al. 2023 Dev Cell and a nucellus panel marker in Liu 2026 JIPB (rice_seed draft). Not raised: Li 2023 shows only a feature plot (not a Table S1 marker), and the gene is also in the ovular vascular trace. Post-anthesis peak.
Uncharacterized gene; in situ in the innermost nucellus, but weak specificity (cl0 pct 0.32 vs 0.11) and also enriched in the young-ovule cluster cl10 (Li et al. 2023 Dev Cell). No MSU ID found.
Uncharacterized gene; in situ in the nucellus, but more enriched in cl10 (log2FC 2.0) than in the nucellus cluster cl0 (1.5) (Li et al. 2023 Dev Cell). No MSU ID found.

Uncharacterized gene; in situ in the vascular tissue below the ovule, highly specific to the unassigned cl12 (pct 0.44 vs 0.004) (Li et al. 2023 Dev Cell). No canonical xylem/phloem gene supports the call; provisional. No MSU ID found.
G2/M cyclin; top DE gene of the unassigned cl13 (Li et al. 2023 Dev Cell). Same gene as the Dividing_cells row of rice_root.tsv (Zhang et al. 2021 Nat Commun) and the rice_seed/rice_embryo drafts.
Cytokinesis-specific syntaxin (G2/M); top DE gene of cl13 (Li et al. 2023 Dev Cell). Also in rice_root.tsv (Zhang 2021) and the rice_seed draft (Jing 2026).
Uncharacterized gene; in situ as scattered dots in the ovule, cl13 log2FC 5.4, pct 0.77 vs 0.007 (Li et al. 2023 Dev Cell). No MSU ID found.

B-class MADS gene for lodicule and stamen identity (Nagasawa et al. 2003 Development); cl11 marker of stamen residues in pistil data (Li et al. 2023 Dev Cell) and enriched in lodicule/stamen clusters of Wang et al. 2025 Nature (cross-study, medium to high). In pistil samples use it to remove stamen contamination.
Farnesyl diphosphate synthase; in situ in stamen residues of pistil samples, cl11 log2FC 5.1, pct 0.48 vs 0.006 (Li et al. 2023 Dev Cell). Contaminant marker; anther cell type not resolved.

Cysteine protease needed for pollen development (Lee et al. 2004 Plant Mol Biol); in situ in stamen residues, cl11 pct 0.81 vs 0.04 (Li et al. 2023 Dev Cell). Conflict: Wang et al. 2025 Nature used it as an in situ palea marker (SP3-4) and it tops their SP8 'ovary wall' cluster, so it is not stamen-specific in whole-flower data.
